content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical education and research institute in Puducherry. These posts are part of a research project run by an outside funder, ICMR. The project is the PReMI Study (Preventing Premature Myocardial Infarction), a community-digital intervention to reduce cardiometabolic risk among young high-risk adults in South India. The Project Investigator is Dr Venkatachalam J of the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 7 posts in total, across three post types. All of them are for the same project, with the same funding agency, Project Investigator and likely duration. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives each post its own essential and desirable requirements, listed below. All three posts have the same age rule: a maximum of 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications (6 November 2026), with relaxation as per GoI guidelines. Two rules apply to every post. The qualification and experience must be in a relevant discipline/field and from a reputed institution/organization. The experience must have been gained after getting the essential qualification. Other essential requirements: Excellent communication skills in Tamil & English. Two-wheeler with DL (Driving License). Desirable: Experience in community-based public health research. Experience working with PHCs or community health programmes. Experience in NCD prevention and control or related public health programmes. Interested in doing extramural Project PhD under the PI. Experience in field-team coordination, participant recruitment, or data collection. Publication in indexed journals. The notice says this project position may be considered for the extramural project PhD stream. In your application, say whether you want to be considered for a PhD position if the Institution approves one in future. Being selected for the post does not guarantee a PhD place. That needs further approval, a pass in an additional written exam and the PI's agreement after selection. The notice points candidates to the PhD guidelines on the JIPMER website. Other essential requirements: Excellent communication skills in Tamil and English. Proficiency in MS Office, especially MS Excel. Desirable: Experience in data management or monitoring in health/public health research projects. Experience with electronic data capture systems or research databases. Experience in data cleaning, validation, and quality checks. Other essential requirements: Excellent communication skills in Tamil & English. Two wheeler with Driving License (DL). Desirable: Experience in community-based health or public health research. Experience in participant recruitment, follow-up, or field-based data collection. Experience in blood pressure measurement, anthropometry and blood sample collection. Experience working with PHCs or community health programmes. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification_as_printed: Post Graduate Degree in public health or epidemiology (or) three years graduate degree with three years' experience in the relevant field / subject.
Three years graduate course or diploma with two Years Experience in relevant subject.
Three years graduate course (Bsc Nursing, Bsc MLT) or diploma with two Years Experience in relevant subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All the posts pay a consolidated monthly amount and no other allowances. The notice also says the consolidated salary may vary from time to time, and no allowance or facility will be given beyond it. Each post has a likely duration of three years.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate day-to-day field activities and study operations. Supervise field staff and support household screening and participant recruitment. Coordinate and monitor delivery of study interventions and follow-up activities. Manage digital messaging and participant communication systems. Maintain field logistics, records, and study-related documentation. Ensure timely and complete data collection and reporting. Manage study databases and digital data capture systems. Perform data entry verification, cleaning, and validation. Monitor data completeness, consistency, and quality. Prepare and organise datasets for statistical analysis. Maintain data records and support routine data reporting. Conduct community-based data collection through household visits. Perform blood pressure measurement and anthropometric assessments. Collect blood samples as per the study protocol. Conduct participant follow-up and provide counselling support. Identify participants with abnormal findings and facilitate referral to PHCs. Maintain accurate study records and ensure timely data collection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for JIPMER Recruitment 2026 are accepted by email only. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Fill in the application form attached to the notification. Scan the filled form, your CV and your supporting documents into one PDF file. Name the PDF file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example is "James_DEO_2023_application"). Write the name of the post you are applying for in the email subject line. Email the PDF to [email protected] by 05.00 pm on 6 November 2026. If you are applying for two or more posts, fill in a separate application form for each post, scan it and send it with its enclosures in a separate email. Documents named in the notice: Filled application form in the prescribed format CV Supporting documents / certificates (documentary proof) Your choice on being considered for the Extramural Project PhD Stream (Project Technical Support – III) A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on the details in their application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be shown on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview. According to the notice's evaluation criteria, these stages may follow the review of the application form. The notice does not say which areas each stage will cover. Written test Skill test Interview Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If there are a very large number of applications, stricter criteria than those listed may be used to decide eligibility. The Project Investigator's decision will be final. The Principal Investigator will decide whether the interview is held in person or by videoconference. For a videoconference, each candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer/laptop/mobile) with audio and camera, plus a good internet connection. The date and time of the interview will be announced after shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, applications not in the prescribed format and applications that do not meet the essential criteria are likely to be summarily rejected. You may attach your CV to the application form. Applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. The Principal Investigator may relax or change the qualification, experience and other terms and conditions. Giving wrong or false information at any stage of selection, or any kind of canvassing, will lead to disqualification. If found after engagement, it can lead to termination. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 2 for Project Technical Support – III, 1 for Project Technical Support – II and 4 for Project Nurse – II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Your application must be emailed to [email protected] by 05.00 pm on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the JIPMER Project Nurse – II post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for "Three years graduate course (Bsc Nursing, Bsc MLT) or diploma with two Years Experience in relevant subject". You also need excellent communication skills in Tamil & English and a two-wheeler with a Driving License.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for JIPMER Project Technical Support – III?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a Post Graduate Degree in public health or epidemiology, or a three years graduate degree with three years' experience in the relevant field / subject. You also need excellent communication skills in Tamil & English and a two-wheeler with a DL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age for all three posts is 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications, with relaxation as per GoI guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the JIPMER project posts?
faq.answer: Project Technical Support – III pays Rs. 33,600/- per month. Project Technical Support – II and Project Nurse – II pay Rs. 24,000/- per month. This is a consolidated amount with no other allowances.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Scan the filled application form, your CV and your supporting documents into one PDF named "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application". Email it to [email protected] with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JIPMER PReMI Study posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on their application, CV and documentary proof. The final selection is based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview, and the evaluation criteria also list a skill test. The interview may be held in person or by videoconference.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JIPMER project job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contract for an externally sponsored ICMR project, with a likely duration of three years. The person engaged will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post in JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Fill in a separate application form for each post and send each one, with its enclosures, in a separate email.
